target_definition: next calendar year's May through October cumulative gross energy (GWh, equivalent to million kWh)
resolver: same six monthly USBR historical gross GWh in the following November's archive; calendar issue date verified; 2026 Most Probable 7 MAF existing archive used for historical rows only

comparators.prior_season: current issue's historical monthly gross energy for the same months one calendar year earlier
comparators.official: same issue's Most Probable future gross energy
comparators.volume_scaled: prior season total gross divided by that season's turbine power-release volume times projected target season's power-release volume
comparators.cap_only: sum of each prior-season month clipped to target-month water energy at documented 590ft maximum head and 100% conversion, with +0.5 thousand acre-ft printing tolerance

primary_metric: equal annual target block mean absolute error of the six-month total in GWh
diagnostics: paired annual MAE differences, signed mean error, block wins and ties, availability, historical rounding differences, cap violations; year blocks may be serially related; no p-values
missing: required source absent, status or definition ambiguous or month missing means ineligible; keep intended calendar without replacement
source_scope: public federal facility only; no use of issuer data, securities prices or returns
known_exposure: the preceding S4-B used some 2025 observations and 2026 archived source documents; no prospective or independent label
